title: tamandua run diagnose (read-only bundle) + tamandua evidence prune (manual, dry-run)

collectors.content: runs, steps, stories, story_abandonments, run_worktrees rows as explicitly projected JSON
run-scoped events/<bareRunId>.jsonl first, then global rotations oldest-to-newest, deduped, order preserved
collectors.absentPolicy: explicit absent marker line; never throws

collectors.content: tamandua.log plus .1..5 lines mentioning the run id or short id
collectors.absentPolicy: explicit absent marker line; never throws

collectors.content: pi/dsh/hermes session-store PATHS only (resolved exactly like token attribution)
collectors.absentPolicy: status 'absent' with the candidate path; never throws

collectors.content: per-run evidence directory listing (paths + sizes, no symlink escape) and suite_results rows with log_path
collectors.absentPolicy: missing root -> 'absent' with totalBytes 0; missing table degrades to 'absent'; never throws

collectors.content: VM ids, console/serial logs, invocation error records, stored mount-plan/policy JSON
collectors.secretHandling: every host-owned JSON value passes through redactSecrets before it is written

collectors.content: summary.json + SUMMARY.md (run status, step/story timeline, retries, force-fail reason, last failing round stderr tail)
collectors.absentPolicy: every missing section is an explicit 'absent' note; never fabricated

bundle.absentPolicy: any missing source is reported as 'absent' in the bundle; no collector or the orchestrator throws
bundle.userFacing: the whole bundle directory is attachable to a bug report; no host-specific assumptions beyond the state dir
bundle.jsonShape: { runId, bundlePath, summary } on stdout, one JSON object

prune.withoutExecute: lists items, sizes and totals; removes nothing
prune.olderThanParsing: bare integer days or <N>d suffix only; milliseconds converted before the age comparison

scope.path: run_worktrees row with status 'removed' whose worktree_path still exists

eligibility.terminalInstant: runs.updated_at must be STRICTLY older than the threshold
eligibility.comparison: isOlderThan(runs.updated_at, olderThanMs, now, 0) from src/lib/instant.ts — numeric, never a string compare
eligibility.liveRunOutcome: every artifact of a live run is refused/kept and listed

refusals: run is running, paused or pending
run scheduling_status is pending_register, queued, waiting, draining_pause or active
artifact cannot be mapped to a known run (orphan diagnostics dir, suite-log without a ledger row, .pending-*.log leftover)
terminal instant is missing or unparseable
terminal instant is not numerically older than the threshold
prune.removedWorktreeRule: only rows already marked status 'removed' whose path still exists are candidates; a missing path is skipped (idempotent)

executorContainment.physical: the deepest existing ancestor's realpath must be inside realpathSync(stateDir)
executorContainment.symlinks: a symlink target itself is unlinked, never followed

prune.refusalReporting: refusals are listed with a reason, never silently dropped
prune.jsonShape: { dryRun, olderThanMs, items, refusals, totals } plus removed/skipped/failed in execute mode

unit.covers: exact id / prefix / #N / bare N resolution, not-found and ambiguous errors
projected run/step/story/worktree rows against an in-memory SQLite db
run-scoped + rotated global event collection, dedupe, corrupt/torn lines
evidence dir listing (no symlink escape) + suite ledger rows
VM ids, logs, error records, redacted policy
summary.json/SUMMARY.md, absent sections, force-fail reason, stderr tail
orchestrator file set, absent sources, Matchlock-shaped fixture, out-root layout
dry-run plan, eligibility, refusals, unknown-artifact keeps
filesystem-only removal, containment, idempotence, symlink handling
run diagnose argument parsing, --json output, exit codes
evidence prune argument parsing, dry-run default, --json output

e2e.covers: CLI diagnose against a scripted run (present sources) and a synthetic absent-sources run
CLI prune dry-run then --yes against a terminal scripted run; live-run refusal

guards.covers: this contract: required top-level keys, gate command set, no host-specific assumptions

gates.note: TypeScript compile + version injection; this is also the typecheck gate

gates.command: node --test src/diagnostics/paths.test.ts src/diagnostics/redact.test.ts src/diagnostics/types.test.ts src/diagnostics/run-target.test.ts src/diagnostics/collect-db.test.ts src/diagnostics/collect-events.test.ts src/diagnostics/collect-logs.test.ts src/diagnostics/collect-evidence.test.ts src/diagnostics/collect-matchlock.test.ts src/diagnostics/summary.test.ts src/diagnostics/prune-plan.test.ts src/diagnostics/prune-exec.test.ts tests/diag-prune-contract.test.ts
gates.note: the new diagnostics/prune/CLI/contract tests alone, split into their parallel and serial lanes
exact TEST_CMD for this run; both lanes must be green (documented host-load flakes re-run green alone)
smoke + scripted tiers (includes e2e-tests/run-diagnose.test.ts and e2e-tests/evidence-prune.test.ts)

notRun.matchlockVmGates: not run — the run's own rounds execute inside VMs; the coordinator certifies on both machines
